title: Vault of Forgotten Art
description: A man in a yellow uniform with 'STAFF' written on the back stands at the entrance of a massive circular vault door glowing with warm light, inside a derelict concrete museum filled with discarded paintings, a marble bust, film reels, broken frames and debris.
prompt: A lone staff member in a yellow uniform stands before a giant ornate circular vault door that is slightly open, emitting warm glowing light. The abandoned concrete gallery around him is filled with discarded framed paintings leaning against walls, a classical marble bust on a pedestal, scattered film reels, broken glass, and debris. Dramatic shafts of light cut through the dusty air, cinematic composition, detailed environment, moody atmosphere
